status: design-only; final Personnel manifest requires in-game survey and target-version schema validation

personnelTarget.policeNpcPopulation: native-game police spawns; not counted as custom roster NPCs

expansion.designRule: Extend outward from Docks and connect to existing roads; do not place a disconnected island district.
expansion.environment: Reuse vanilla buildings, props, road pieces, lighting, interiors and interaction prefabs wherever possible.

gameSystems: vehicle route only after compatibility check

customerProfileRules.persistence: Generate once from a stable per-NPC seed and save the resolved values; never reroll on reload or client join.
customerProfileRules.validity: Choose only product/effect identifiers verified in the target game and Personnel schema. Avoid impossible or empty preference sets.
customerProfileRules.uniqueness: Use weighted random selection with duplicate-profile detection; if a collision occurs, reroll only the conflicting profile.
notes: customer-designs.json remains design input, not a raw Personnel manifest.
Randomized resolved values must be exported into the final manifest and remain stable across saves.

appearanceRules.system: Personnel avatar settings and vanilla avatar layer library
fields: height and weight within vanilla-safe ranges
appearanceRules.uniqueness: Build an appearance fingerprint from all resolved appearance fields. Reject duplicates within Harborline and reroll from available vanilla avatar assets; never rely on random chance alone.
constraints: Use only avatar layer paths confirmed to exist in the installed game version.
Do not create custom PNG layers unless needed; vanilla layers improve compatibility.
Keep stable appearance seed per NPC so save/load and co-op clients render the same character.
appearanceRules.fallback: If the available vanilla avatar pool cannot guarantee uniqueness, expand the valid combinations or reduce simultaneous roster size; do not silently reuse a full appearance.

policeIntegration.spawnPolicy: Allow the game's native police spawn/dispatch logic to select Harborline as a valid region after its region and road/navigation registration is verified.
policeIntegration.patrols: Use existing police patrol/vehicle/response systems; do not create client-only police or duplicate dispatch logic.

multiplayer.npcSpawn: one authoritative registration/spawn per save and stable NPC id
multiplayer.state: Persist customer preferences, appearance seed, schedule and relevant NPC state on host/save; clients consume replicated state.
multiplayer.lateJoin: Late joiners receive the same NPC state without creating another copy.
multiplayer.dependencies: All players must install the same mod version and required Personnel/S1API dependencies; validate version/hash mismatch and fail safely.
multiplayer.conflicts: Use namespaced IDs, additive hooks, feature detection and optional integrations; never replace vanilla singleton systems or hard-depend on unrelated mods.
multiplayer.degradedMode: If optional integration is absent, disable only that integration and log a clear warning.

releaseRules: Stable explicit NPC ids before first public save.
Never publish a physical NPC without measured spawn coordinates.
Start with 3-5 NPCs, then scale after spawn, schedule, persistence, multiplayer, police and performance tests.
Target population is a design goal, not a guarantee all NPCs are active simultaneously.
Native police population is additional to the custom NPC target and is governed by the game's own police system.
